rules.description: Compose intent could not be represented by the neutral application model.
rules.help: Correct the reported Compose value or remove the conflicting declaration.
rules.name: compose-model-invalid

rules.description: Profiled Compose services require an explicit profile selection.
rules.help: Select profiles explicitly with --profile, or use --all-profiles only after reviewing mutually exclusive services.
rules.name: compose-profile-selection-required

rules.description: The Compose profile selection is invalid or belongs to another merged project.
rules.help: Recreate the profile selection from the same merged Compose project.
rules.name: compose-profile-selection-mismatch

rules.description: Compose intent is not represented by the current neutral-model subset.
rules.help: Review the named feature; use --loss-policy partial only when omitting that intent is acceptable.
rules.name: compose-intent-unsupported

rules.description: A Compose value cannot be represented safely in the neutral model.
rules.help: Correct the reported value before converting again.
rules.name: compose-value-invalid

rules.description: The requested Compose output target is invalid.
rules.help: Select a supported Compose target profile and compatible version inputs.
rules.name: compose-target-invalid

rules.description: Neutral application intent is not represented in generated Compose output.
rules.help: Review the named subject; use --loss-policy partial only when the omitted intent is acceptable.
rules.name: compose-output-unsupported

rules.description: ComposeLens rejected generated Compose output.
rules.help: Correct the reported neutral value or target choice and retry.
rules.name: compose-generation-failed

rules.description: Generated Compose syntax has a target-specific compatibility constraint.
rules.help: Review the target-specific classification before authorizing non-exact output.
rules.name: compose-compatibility-constraint

rules.description: A Compose interpolation variable is not set.
rules.help: Provide the missing value with --env-file FILE or --env NAME=VALUE.
rules.name: compose-unset-variable

rules.description: A required Compose interpolation variable is not set.
rules.help: Provide the required value with --env-file FILE or --env NAME=VALUE.
rules.name: compose-required-variable

rules.description: A Compose interpolation expression is invalid.
rules.help: Correct the interpolation expression and retry.
rules.name: compose-interpolation-invalid

rules.description: A Compose interpolation expression exceeds the supported nesting limit.
rules.help: Simplify the interpolation expression before converting.
rules.name: compose-interpolation-nesting-limit

rules.description: A Compose variable expression remains unresolved at the adapter boundary.
rules.help: Use --interpolate and provide missing values with --env-file FILE or --env NAME=VALUE; partial authorization applies only when the affected intent can be omitted.
rules.name: compose-unresolved-variable

rules.description: ComposeLens reported a native Compose error.
rules.help: Use the retained source code and source span to correct the Compose document.
rules.name: compose-native-error

rules.description: ComposeLens reported a native Compose warning.
rules.help: Review the retained source code and source span before accepting the document.
rules.name: compose-native-warning

rules.description: ComposeLens reported native Compose information.
rules.help: Review the retained source code when more context is needed.
rules.name: compose-native-note

rules.description: BoxFerry could not complete the requested orchestration stage.
rules.help: Review the reason and correct the command inputs before retrying.
rules.name: orchestration-failed

rules.description: An explicitly selected input could not be read.
rules.help: Check that the input exists, is a readable regular file, and is not a symlink.
rules.name: input-read-failed

rules.description: The Compose project root could not be resolved.
rules.help: Provide an existing absolute --project-directory or correct the input location.
rules.name: compose-project-root-invalid

rules.description: The requested Podman target range could not be resolved.
rules.help: Use major.minor or major.minor.patch values within the reviewed range.
rules.name: podman-target-selection-invalid

rules.description: Compose interpolation inputs could not be resolved safely.
rules.help: Correct the named --env-file or --env input and retry.
rules.name: interpolation-input-invalid

rules.description: Compose input could not be loaded or merged.
rules.help: Correct the reported Compose source diagnostic before retrying.
rules.name: compose-load-failed

rules.description: Source import or target conversion failed.
rules.help: Correct the reported rule occurrences before retrying.
rules.name: conversion-failed

rules.description: Quadlet input could not be parsed into the native document boundary.
rules.help: Correct the retained native diagnostics before retrying.
rules.name: quadlet-parse-failed

rules.description: The selected output directory is not empty.
rules.help: Empty the selected --output-directory or choose a new path.
rules.name: output-directory-not-empty

rules.description: The selected output path is not a usable non-symlink directory.
rules.help: Choose an absent path or an existing empty, non-symlink directory.
rules.name: output-path-invalid

rules.description: Generated output could not be written safely.
rules.help: Check parent-directory existence, permissions, free space, and path conflicts.
rules.name: output-write-failed

rules.description: The structured report file could not be written safely.
rules.help: Choose a new writable --report-file path.
rules.name: report-write-failed

rules.description: The diagnostic support bundle could not be written safely.
rules.help: Choose a writable --error-report-directory with space for a new archive.
rules.name: support-bundle-write-failed

rules.description: Inspected Podman evidence is malformed, incomplete, or unavailable for a required mapping.
rules.help: Correct the selected Podman resources or selectors, then acquire a complete read-only inventory again.
rules.name: podman-source-invalid

rules.description: Inspected Podman intent is not represented by the current neutral application model.
rules.help: Review the named field; use --loss-policy partial only when omitting that intent is acceptable.
rules.name: podman-input-unmodelled

rules.description: Effective or locally resolved Podman evidence requires an explicit promotion decision.
rules.help: Choose an explicit promotion policy only after confirming the observed value is portable desired state.
rules.name: podman-promotion-required

rules.description: Podman resource identities or references conflict in the neutral namespace.
rules.help: Narrow the selectors or rename the conflicting resources before importing again.
rules.name: podman-identity-conflict

rules.description: Podman inspection lacks authored secret-delivery information required for a portable grant.
rules.help: Author the secret delivery form and target separately; inspection metadata alone is insufficient.
rules.name: podman-secret-grant-incomplete

rules.description: The requested Podman output target is outside the reviewed exact version and execution-context catalogue.
rules.help: Select a reviewed --podman-max-version and state the target rootful, rootless, or unknown context explicitly.
rules.name: podman-target-invalid

rules.description: Neutral application intent is not represented by the current Podman deployment subset.
rules.help: Review the named subject; use --loss-policy partial only when the omitted intent is acceptable.
rules.name: podman-output-unsupported

rules.description: PodmanLens could not produce or render a complete reviewable deployment plan.
rules.help: Review retained PodmanLens findings, correct the neutral intent or target, and retry.
rules.name: podman-planning-failed

rules.description: The requested Quadlet target or Podman range is invalid.
rules.help: Select the podman target and a version range covered by QuadletLens.
rules.name: quadlet-target-invalid

rules.description: An omitted Podman maximum extends beyond verified compatibility evidence.
rules.help: Set --podman-maximum-version for a finite compatibility claim.
rules.name: quadlet-open-ended-target

rules.description: Neutral application intent is not represented by the current Quadlet subset.
rules.help: Review the named subject; use --loss-policy partial only when omission is acceptable.
rules.name: quadlet-output-unsupported

rules.description: A neutral value cannot be emitted safely as native Quadlet syntax.
rules.help: Correct or explicitly map the reported value before converting again.
rules.name: quadlet-value-invalid

rules.description: QuadletLens rejected generated native output.
rules.help: Correct the reported value or dependency and retry.
rules.name: quadlet-generation-failed

rules.description: A required Quadlet capability is unavailable for part of the target range.
rules.help: Narrow the Podman target range or accept the documented partial result.
rules.name: quadlet-capability-unavailable

rules.description: Generated Quadlet grouping changes source service isolation.
rules.help: Use --quadlet-grouping pod only when the shared-pod semantics are acceptable.
rules.name: quadlet-grouping-approximation

rules.description: A service dependency cannot be represented exactly by Quadlet and systemd.
rules.help: Review the dependency condition and complete unsupported behavior manually.
rules.name: quadlet-dependency-unsupported

rules.description: Container restart behavior is approximated by the systemd service manager.
rules.help: Use --loss-policy approximate only after accepting the documented systemd behavior difference.
rules.name: quadlet-restart-policy-approximation

rules.description: Environment-file parsing is delegated to Podman.
rules.help: Verify the environment file with the target Podman version before deployment.
rules.name: quadlet-environment-file-approximation

rules.description: The requested Quadlet grouping cannot preserve the application topology.
rules.help: Keep separate containers or correct the reported grouping conflict.
rules.name: quadlet-grouping-invalid

rules.description: The service or image-artifact dependency graph is invalid.
rules.help: Correct missing or cyclic dependencies before converting.
rules.name: quadlet-dependency-invalid

rules.description: A required Quadlet capability is deprecated for part of the target range.
rules.help: Review the target range and plan migration away from the deprecated capability.
rules.name: quadlet-capability-deprecated

rules.description: A source variable expression cannot be emitted as a Quadlet value.
rules.help: Resolve source variables before conversion; for Compose input, use --interpolate and provide missing values with --env-file FILE or --env NAME=VALUE.
rules.name: quadlet-unresolved-source-variable

rules.description: The Quadlet document set is invalid.
rules.help: Correct native Quadlet syntax and document-set errors before converting.
rules.name: quadlet-source-invalid

rules.description: Quadlet intent cannot be represented by the neutral application model.
rules.help: Correct the reported native value or relationship.
rules.name: quadlet-model-invalid

rules.description: Quadlet intent is outside the current neutral-model importer subset.
rules.help: Review the named key; use --loss-policy partial only when omission is acceptable.
rules.name: quadlet-input-unsupported

rules.description: Quadlet intent is approximated in the neutral model.
rules.help: Review the documented semantic difference before authorizing approximate output.
rules.name: quadlet-input-approximation

rules.description: QuadletLens reported a native syntax diagnostic.
rules.help: Use the retained source code and source span to correct the Quadlet unit.
rules.name: quadlet-native-syntax

rules.description: QuadletLens reported a native model diagnostic.
rules.help: Use the retained source code and source span to correct the Quadlet value.
rules.name: quadlet-native-model

rules.description: QuadletLens reported a native document-set diagnostic.
rules.help: Correct missing, ambiguous, or invalid cross-document relationships.
rules.name: quadlet-native-document-set

rules.description: QuadletLens could not construct the native input boundary.
rules.help: Correct the reported input and native stage before retrying.
rules.name: quadlet-native-failure
